_comment: WHITELIST. Only repos listed here can ever appear on the profile.
Activity decides the ORDER; this file decides what is publishable at all.
A repo you push to that is not listed here is silently skipped -- so a new
private experiment can never leak onto your profile by default.
Key   = owner/repo exactly as GitHub spells it. Most of these live under the
GoodStuffSoftware org, NOT the personal account -- a key with the wrong
owner silently never matches and the project just never appears.
label = what the world sees. For a private repo make this say what it IS
blurb = one short line. Keep it under ~80 chars or the table wraps badly.
link  = optional. Omit for private repos -- a 404 link looks broken.

GoodStuffSoftware/agent-templates.label: Agent Templates
GoodStuffSoftware/agent-templates.blurb: Vendor-agnostic library of agent-team templates for AI coding tools.

GoodStuffSoftware/agent-plugins.label: Agent Plugins
GoodStuffSoftware/agent-plugins.blurb: Roam Claude Code conversations between machines, and more.

GoodStuffSoftware/gss-stats.label: GSS Stats
GoodStuffSoftware/gss-stats.blurb: Bot-free web analytics dashboard on Cloudflare.

GoodStuffSoftware/gss-beacon.label: GSS Beacon
GoodStuffSoftware/gss-beacon.blurb: Bot-free geo/analytics beacon on Cloudflare Pages Functions.

GoodStuffSoftware/deckhand.label: Agent tracking & comms
GoodStuffSoftware/deckhand.blurb: Coordination and messaging layer for multi-agent workflows.
GoodStuffSoftware/deckhand._note: CHECK THE KEY -- guessed. If it is still named dh, or sits on the personal account, this entry never matches. The label is what the world sees; the repo name is never rendered.

GoodStuffSoftware/best-sudoku.label: Best Sudoku
GoodStuffSoftware/best-sudoku.blurb: No ads, no subscription. Pay once. Web and Android.
GoodStuffSoftware/best-sudoku._note: CHECK THE KEY -- not in the org's PUBLIC list, so it is private or named differently.

GoodStuffSoftware/simple-tile.label: Simple Tile
GoodStuffSoftware/simple-tile.blurb: Browser tool for seamless repeating tile patterns.
GoodStuffSoftware/simple-tile._note: CHECK THE KEY -- not in the org's PUBLIC list, so it is private or named differently.
